overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated Indian gooseberry powder for global commercial applications. As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain a systematic six-step process spanning sourcing, cleaning, controlled drying, grinding, inspection, and dispatch. Our processing yields a fine 100 mesh powder with less than 7.0% moisture, ensuring consistent flowability and dependable quality for industrial formulation.

We provide bulk supply and comprehensive OEM private label services for food processors, beverage manufacturers, and personal care brands. Operating with a low minimum order quantity of 5 kg, we offer custom packaging and particle sizing on request. Importers benefit from complete export documentation support and sample evaluation, ensuring seamless integration into varied manufacturing lines.
highlights: Free from artificial additives and fillers
Authentic characteristic sour and astringent profile
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bags and HDPE containers
Retail-ready private label pouches and jars
Custom bulk packaging tailored on request

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Indian gooseberry powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating both pilot trials and large commercial orders.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes for our processing needs?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer custom grinding and sieving specifications upon request to match your formulation criteria.

faqs.q: What private label and packaging options do you offer?
faqs.a: We provide complete OEM private label solutions, including small retail pouches, jars, and bulk packaging.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples prior to bulk purchasing?
faqs.a: Yes, commercial samples are available on request to assist your product evaluation and testing.

faqs.q: What export support does TradeNest Naturals provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we furnish comprehensive export documentation support for international shipments.

faqs.q: How should this botanical powder be stored?
faqs.a: Store the powder in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and ambient moisture.
